topic: Where is the longest land border on Earth? (Canada – United States, 8,891 km)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

ibc_about.title: About Us
ibc_about.notes: 8,891 km (5,525 mi) from the St. Croix River on the Atlantic to the Strait of Juan de Fuca on the Pacific, and from Tongass Passage to the Arctic Ocean; 'the world's longest land border between two adjoining countries'; ~20 agreements; IBC since 1908

ibc_facts.title: Boundary Facts
ibc_facts.notes: maintains the 8,891 km boundary; over 8,000 monuments and reference points; keeps a 6 metre (20 ft) clear vista; 2,172 km through forest requiring clearing; 5,528 boundary monuments; shortest distance between two monuments 46 cm; Atlantic–Pacific 6,416 km; Pacific–Arctic (Alaska) 2,475 km

cia_land.title: Land boundaries (2022 archive)
cia_land.notes: Canada: US 8,891 km (includes 2,475 km with Alaska); Kazakhstan–Russia 7,644 km; Argentina–Chile 6,691 km

wiki_border.title: Canada–United States border
wiki_border.notes: 8,891 km total: 6,416 km with the contiguous US, 2,475 km with Alaska; longest international border in the world by total length; the boundary vista is a 6 m (20 ft) deforested strip ('slash') maintained by the IBC; over 8,000 boundary monuments; 2,475 km Alaska; Derby Line (Vermont) / Stanstead (Quebec): the line runs through the Haskell Free Library

wiki_borders_list.notes: Longest land border between two countries: Canada–United States 8,891 km; then Kazakhstan–Russia

statcan.title: International perspective (Canada Year Book 2011)
statcan.notes: world's longest international border at 8,890 km; compared with Russia–Kazakhstan and Chile–Argentina

cbc_numbers.title: The Canada-U.S. border: by the numbers
cbc_numbers.notes: 8,891 km across land and water; 2,477 km with Alaska alone; 119 crossings; 8,000+ monuments; a 6-metre vista

claims.text: The Canada–United States border is the longest land border between two countries: 8,891 km (5,525 mi), from the Atlantic to the Pacific and from the Pacific to the Arctic (Alaska). Runners-up: Kazakhstan–Russia 7,644 km, Argentina–Chile 6,691 km (CIA).
vo: where is the longest land border on earth
canada and the usa, kazakhstan and russia, or argentina and chile
canada and the usa: eight thousand eight hundred and ninety-one kilometres, no wall, one line from the atlantic to the pacific, then alaska to the arctic
screen: Where is the LONGEST land border on Earth?

claims.text: The Alaska–Canada section (Pacific to Arctic) is 2,475 km; the contiguous-US section is 6,416 km.
vo: alaska alone adds 2,475 kilometres, all the way up to the arctic ocean

claims.text: The International Boundary Commission keeps a 6 m (20 ft) wide clear vista along the land boundary; 2,172 km of it runs through forest that must be cleared regularly.
vo: through forest, a six metre strip is kept clear so the line stays visible

claims.text: Over 8,000 monuments and reference points mark the boundary (5,528 boundary monuments); the shortest distance between two monuments is 46 cm (18 in). (not used in this cut)
Not a single wall: the boundary is marked by monuments and cleared vistas, maintained cooperatively by the IBC since 1908; it is often called the longest undefended border.
vo: ocean to ocean, one unbroken line

claims.text: Runner-up land borders: Kazakhstan–Russia 7,644 km and Argentina–Chile 6,691 km, i.e. 1,247 km and 2,200 km shorter than Canada–US (8,891 km).
vo: second place, kazakhstan and russia, is more than 1,200 kilometres shorter

myths.myth: Russia has the longest border with one neighbour.
myths.reality: Russia has the most neighbours and the longest total border, but the longest single two-country border is Canada–US (8,891 km); Kazakhstan–Russia is second.

guardrails.why: Contested name — say 'the Gulf' or use both names (docs/BORDER_POLICY.md).
Sovereignty language on disputed areas is banned; say administers / claims.
Marketing phrase, not a measured fact; the IBC says 'cooperatively maintained'.

landscape.our_gap: Feed answers say 'Canada–USA' over a stock photo; nobody draws the actual line ocean to ocean, adds the Alaska leg and the 6-metre cut through the forest.
